title: Bock OptiTherm: preventative maintenance and tank warranty claim
equipment: Bock OptiTherm water heaters and tanks (from the Bock maintenance sheet and warranty claim steps)

r_pm.cause: The 2026 Bock OptiTherm maintenance sheet covers a standard visit.
fix: For the OT200-299N model, replace the flame rod with gasket (part 19852R) and the hot surface ignitor with gasket (part 19948R); the OT300-500N has its own sheet.
Inspect/check: water pipes, T&P relief valve, power anode system, vent system, combustion system, tank and condensate trap.
Run and test the system. The sheet also lists a 6-month wellness check-up.
Pricing and labor rates are on the spreadsheet, not repeated here.

r_claim.cause: Tank warranty claims are filed through the Bock account portal.
fix: Log in, go to My Account, click Warranty Request, select the tank category and complete the form.
Bock must receive the ratings label from the failed tank (pictures are not accepted; a removed and scanned label is) and the Bock replacement serial number before credit can be processed.
